title: Salesforce Developer, Quote-to-Cash
jobDescription:
Responsibilities Develop, configure, and support Salesforce solutions using Apex, SOQL, Salesforce Flows, validation rules, custom objects, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) under guidance from senior developers and Technical Leads. Take ownership of assigned deliverables, demonstrating accountability for delivering high-quality solutions within agreed timelines. Assist in translating business requirements and user stories into technical tasks, configuration changes, and development deliverables. Support enhancements across Salesforce capabilities related to Quote-to-Cash, quoting, order management, assets, renewals, and related business processes. Participate in unit testing, peer reviews, defect resolution, and release validation to ensure quality and reliability of delivered solutions. Troubleshoot Salesforce issues, including configuration defects, data issues, flow errors, permission issues, and integration-related errors. Support integration-related development and issue analysis between Salesforce and downstream systems such as Zuora, Workday, Service Now, and middleware platforms. Maintain technical documentation, including configuration notes, data mappings, design details, and deployment steps. Collaborate with QA to validate expected behavior, reproduce defects, and confirm fixes across environments. Follow established development standards, release processes, change controls, and security guidelines. Continuously build Salesforce platform expertise, demonstrate a proactive learning mindset, and contribute ideas for improving system quality, maintainability, and operational efficiency. Required Qualifications 2–5 years of experience in Salesforce development, configuration, or enterprise application development. Hands-on experience with Apex, SOQL, Salesforce Flows, validation rules, custom objects, and basic Salesforce configuration. Foundational understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model, profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchy. Experience supporting or developing in a structured software delivery lifecycle, including requirements review, build, test, and deployment. Ability to troubleshoot issues using debug logs, error messages, data analysis, and collaboration with senior technical resources. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to investigate issues thoroughly. Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering software solutions and resolving technical issues. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Owners, Business Systems Analysts, QA, and other developers. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to ask clarifying questions and document work clearly. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or Quote-to-Cash processes. Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with Salesforce integrations, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or asynchronous processing. Exposure to Zuora Billing, Workday, Service Now, or other enterprise Saa S platforms. Experience using Git Hub, CI/CD pipelines, deployment tools, or version control practices. Salesforce certification such as Platform Developer I, Administrator, or App Builder is a plus. Experience working in Agile delivery teams with Jira, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and defect management. Working at Genesys AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. What Happens After You Apply After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team. A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team. We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases. After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps. Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
jobDescription:
responsibilities will include (but are not limited to): Sales Strategy and Execution: Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve revenue targets within the assigned territory (Western India). Identify and qualify new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, and lead generation activities. Manage the full sales cycle, from initial contact and needs assessment to proposal development, negotiation, and deal closure. Account Management & Growth: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at existing customer accounts. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Genesys Ccaa S solutions to expand our footprint within existing clients. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention by providing exceptional account management and support. New Logo Acquisition: Identify and target key prospects in the Western India market, focusing on specific verticals (e.g: E-Comm, Healthcare, Retail, GCC, Tech). Conduct in-depth needs analysis to understand customer challenges and requirements. Develop and present compelling value propositions that showcase the benefits of Genesys Ccaa S solutions. Product Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of Genesys Ccaa S solutions, including features, functionality, and competitive differentiators. Effectively communicate the value proposition of our solutions to both technical and business audiences. Collaboration & Reporting: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Solution Consulting, marketing, Business Development, professional services) to ensure customer success. Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts and reports to management. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities in the CRM system. You’ve been there and done this… Experience: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering/Technology) and/or Business Administration, Sales, Marketing 10+ years of experience in sales, with a proven track record of success in selling complex software solutions. Experience selling AI driven Ccaa S, contact center solutions, is highly preferred. Experience in the Western India market and a strong understanding of the local business landscape. Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong negotiation and closing skills. Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Proven ability to manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure. Strong business acumen and understanding of customer business needs. Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently. Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). Attributes: Hunter mentality with a passion for driving new business. Customer-centric approach with a focus on building long-term partnerships. Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Strong work ethic and a commitment to achieving results.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Engineering and/or Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA). Existing network of contacts within the Western India business community. title: Principal Cloud Network Engineer (AWS, SD-WAN)
jobDescription:
requirements for availability, latency, security, and operational excellence. You will own and evolve the AWS networking foundation that underpins mission-critical, revenue-impacting platforms, while also integrating Azure networking where required to support a multi-cloud strategy. You are expected to work deeply in production systems—authoring Terraform, writing automation, debugging live routing issues, and improving reliability at scale. As a Principal IC, you hold direct ownership of technical decisions, influence standards used globally, and are accountable for long-term network health and evolution. In parallel, you act as a technical mentor and force multiplier, raising the bar for cloud networking and automation skills across the organization through hands-on collaboration, pairing, and cross-training. This is not a review-only or advisory role—you lead by building, operating, and improving real systems that customers depend on every day. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Why This Role ? Global, customer-facing impact: You will work on networks that directly support a platform used by millions of agents across the globe, where availability and performance have immediate customer and business impact. Real scale, real ownership: This role operates across 20+ AWS regions, multi-account architectures, and complex hybrid connectivity. You are trusted to make and own high-impact technical decisions end to end—from design through production. Principal IC growth path: This role sits on a long-term individual contributor career track, offering the opportunity to expand technical influence, shape global standards, and grow without moving into people management. Modern, engineering-first culture: Automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted operations are core expectations—not side projects. We prioritize durable systems, blameless learning, and continuous improvement over manual heroics. Global collaboration and visibility: You will work closely with architects, platform teams, SREs, and security partners across regions, influencing designs and practices used worldwide. AWS Cloud Networking, Hybrid, Multi-Cloud Engineering Design, implement, and operate large-scale AWS network architectures, including: VPC and subnet design, Transit Gateway and multi-account connectivity, VPC peering and Private Link, Load balancing, NAT, and routing strategies Build and maintain highly available, low-latency AWS networks across multiple regions. Actively troubleshoot and resolve complex AWS networking issues in production environments. Continuously optimize AWS network designs for scalability, security, and operational efficiency. Provide hands-on guidance for Azure networking implementations to ensure interoperability and consistency. Implement and operate hybrid connectivity between on-premises environments and AWS using Direct Connect, VPN, and BGP. Integrate Azure networking components (VNets, gateways, peering, routing) into hybrid and multi-cloud architectures. Own global routing behavior across on-prem and cloud environments, including traffic engineering and failover. Support secure connectivity to Saa S platforms and global office locations. Automation, AI & Self-Healing Networks Build automation-first network operations, not manual runbooks. Design and implement self-healing network workflows using telemetry, event-driven automation, and intelligent remediation. Partner with Cloud and Platform teams to feed network telemetry into AI-powered monitoring and analytics platforms. Reduce incident volume and MTTR through predictive alerting, automated validation, and remediation. Continuously replace repetitive operational tasks with automation. Own global routing strategies across cloud and on-prem environments, including BGP design and traffic engineering Lead the adoption of AI‑assisted networking and AIOps practices to improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency. Infrastructure as Code & Engineering Excellence Author and maintain Terraform code for all cloud networking components. Build reusable, modular Ia C patterns that enable consistent global deployments. Develop automation using Python, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines for provisioning, validation, and lifecycle management. Enforce engineering best practices: version control, peer reviews, testing, and safe change rollout. Treat network infrastructure as production software. Collaborate on WAN and SD-WAN integration strategies supporting cloud connectivity and global traffic optimization Mentorship, Cross-Training & Technical Leadership Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through hands-on pairing, design walkthroughs, and code reviews. Lead cross-training efforts to upskill traditional network engineers in cloud, automation, and Ia C. Share deep AWS networking expertise through documentation, workshops, and real-world problem solving. Lead by example—writing code, debugging incidents, and improving systems directly. Architecture, Operations, Reliability Strategic Influence Collaborate with Network Architecture and Cloud Platform teams to shape future-state designs. Translate architectural direction into working, production-ready implementations. Influence standards and roadmaps through proven solutions rather than abstract designs. Participate in global on-call rotations and lead hands-on response to high-severity incidents. Perform deep root-cause analysis and implement permanent, automated fixes. Improve observability, documentation, and operational readiness across the network platform. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
10+ years of network engineering experience with significant hands-on production ownership. Expert-level AWS cloud networking experience (design, build, operate). Strong practical experience with Azure networking in enterprise or hybrid environments. AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty (required). Deep understanding of enterprise routing, BGP, and traffic engineering. Strong Terraform experience in production environments. Automation and scripting experience (Python preferred). Proven ability to mentor engineers through direct technical engagement. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact architectural decisions. Preferred Qualifications (Good to have) Experience operating global networks at Saa S or hyperscale environments Familiarity with AIOps platforms or custom analytics pipelines. requirements for availability, latency, security, and operational excellence. You will own and evolve the AWS networking foundation that underpins mission-critical, revenue-impacting platforms, while also integrating Azure networking where required to support a multi-cloud strategy. You are expected to work deeply in production systems—authoring Terraform, writing automation, debugging live routing issues, and improving reliability at scale. As a Principal IC, you hold direct ownership of technical decisions, influence standards used globally, and are accountable for long-term network health and evolution. In parallel, you act as a technical mentor and force multiplier, raising the bar for cloud networking and automation skills across the organization through hands-on collaboration, pairing, and cross-training. This is not a review-only or advisory role—you lead by building, operating, and improving real systems that customers depend on every day. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Why This Role ? Global, customer-facing impact: You will work on networks that directly support a platform used by millions of agents across the globe, where availability and performance have immediate customer and business impact. Real scale, real ownership: This role operates across 20+ AWS regions, multi-account architectures, and complex hybrid connectivity. You are trusted to make and own high-impact technical decisions end to end—from design through production. Principal IC growth path: This role sits on a long-term individual contributor career track, offering the opportunity to expand technical influence, shape global standards, and grow without moving into people management. Modern, engineering-first culture: Automation, infrastructure as code, observability, and AI-assisted operations are core expectations—not side projects. We prioritize durable systems, blameless learning, and continuous improvement over manual heroics. Global collaboration and visibility: You will work closely with architects, platform teams, SREs, and security partners across regions, influencing designs and practices used worldwide. AWS Cloud Networking, Hybrid, Multi-Cloud Engineering Design, implement, and operate large-scale AWS network architectures, including: VPC and subnet design, Transit Gateway and multi-account connectivity, VPC peering and Private Link, Load balancing, NAT, and routing strategies Build and maintain highly available, low-latency AWS networks across multiple regions. Actively troubleshoot and resolve complex AWS networking issues in production environments. Continuously optimize AWS network designs for scalability, security, and operational efficiency. Provide hands-on guidance for Azure networking implementations to ensure interoperability and consistency. Implement and operate hybrid connectivity between on-premises environments and AWS using Direct Connect, VPN, and BGP. Integrate Azure networking components (VNets, gateways, peering, routing) into hybrid and multi-cloud architectures. Own global routing behavior across on-prem and cloud environments, including traffic engineering and failover. Support secure connectivity to Saa S platforms and global office locations. Automation, AI & Self-Healing Networks Build automation-first network operations, not manual runbooks. Design and implement self-healing network workflows using telemetry, event-driven automation, and intelligent remediation. Partner with Cloud and Platform teams to feed network telemetry into AI-powered monitoring and analytics platforms. Reduce incident volume and MTTR through predictive alerting, automated validation, and remediation. Continuously replace repetitive operational tasks with automation. Own global routing strategies across cloud and on-prem environments, including BGP design and traffic engineering Lead the adoption of AI‑assisted networking and AIOps practices to improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency. Infrastructure as Code & Engineering Excellence Author and maintain Terraform code for all cloud networking components. Build reusable, modular Ia C patterns that enable consistent global deployments. Develop automation using Python, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines for provisioning, validation, and lifecycle management. Enforce engineering best practices: version control, peer reviews, testing, and safe change rollout. Treat network infrastructure as production software. Collaborate on WAN and SD-WAN integration strategies supporting cloud connectivity and global traffic optimization Mentorship, Cross-Training & Technical Leadership Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through hands-on pairing, design walkthroughs, and code reviews. Lead cross-training efforts to upskill traditional network engineers in cloud, automation, and Ia C. Share deep AWS networking expertise through documentation, workshops, and real-world problem solving. Lead by example—writing code, debugging incidents, and improving systems directly. Architecture, Operations, Reliability Strategic Influence Collaborate with Network Architecture and Cloud Platform teams to shape future-state designs. Translate architectural direction into working, production-ready implementations. Influence standards and roadmaps through proven solutions rather than abstract designs. Participate in global on-call rotations and lead hands-on response to high-severity incidents. Perform deep root-cause analysis and implement permanent, automated fixes. Improve observability, documentation, and operational readiness across the network platform. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
10+ years of network engineering experience with significant hands-on production ownership. Expert-level AWS cloud networking experience (design, build, operate). Strong practical experience with Azure networking in enterprise or hybrid environments. AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty (required). Deep understanding of enterprise routing, BGP, and traffic engineering. Strong Terraform experience in production environments. Automation and scripting experience (Python preferred). Proven ability to mentor engineers through direct technical engagement. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact architectural decisions. Preferred Qualifications (Good to have) Experience operating global networks at Saa S or hyperscale environments Familiarity with AIOps platforms or custom analytics pipelines. Experience with SD‑WAN and global traffic optimization strategies. Good to have
